prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Make a NEW calm toe-tapping idle animation for the exact existing pixel-art woman in the reference. Use only the standing appearance from its first two top-left frames. Keep her face, long black hair, pink clip, impassive eyes, black wrap jacket with cobalt trim, pink sash, black short pleated skirt with blue hem, bare knees, black lace-up boots, lowered hand and slack steel chain EXACTLY consistent with this approved game art. Same tall proportions and crisp detailed pixel art; not chibi, no new costume, no painterly rendering.
Output exactly 8 complete full-body animation frames in a strict 4-column by 2-row grid, 1536x1024 transparent PNG. Uniform equal cells. Same camera, body scale, hip/head/heel registration, generous transparent gutters; no text, labels, grid, floor or shadow.
She faces right in 3/4 view, quietly bored. UPPER BODY, head, arms and supporting LEFT/back leg stay still throughout the loop. Feet do NOT step sideways or travel. One planted supporting foot remains fixed. Animate only the FRONT/RIGHT BOOT lightly rocking its toe up and tapping down while its HEEL STAYS ON THE SAME FLOOR POINT like a hinge. Bare lower leg and ankle articulate slightly naturally; no whole-body bouncing.
Exact row-major progression:
1 neutral: front boot flat, weight on supporting leg.
2 front toe begins to lift, heel grounded.
3 front toe visibly raised higher, ankle flexed.
4 highest toe-up position, about 20 degrees up; heel grounded, knee very slightly relaxed.
5 toe descending halfway.
6 toe almost touching the ground.
7 toe touches down flat, a soft tap, no effects.
8 resting in same flat position as frame1 to close seamless loop.
Toe-up silhouettes MUST be visibly different from flat boots, with transparent air under the raised toe. Lift only the forefoot, not the entire foot. Do not alternate feet; this is one foot idly tapping in place. Keep upper-body drawing and facial expression as unchanged as possible. Tiny chain sway is optional but not a substitute for toe motion. Every frame must include her entire boots and chain without cropping. Genuine alpha transparency, no background or glow.
